+    if not user_ids:
+        return []
+    placeholders = ", ".join("?" * len(user_ids))
+    rows = _conn.execute(
+        f"SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY id",

cd /repo && python - <<'PY'
from app.api.handlers import handle_users_by_ids

cases = [
    ({"ids": ["1", "3"]}, (200, {"users": [
        {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"},
        {"id": 3, "name": "Grace Hopper", "email": "grace@example.com"},
    ]})),
    ({"ids": ["3", "1", "3", "99"]}, (200, {"users": [
        {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"},
        {"id": 3, "name": "Grace Hopper", "email": "grace@example.com"},
    ]})),
    ({"ids": ["99"]}, (200, {"users": []})),
    ({}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
    ({"ids": "1"}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
    ({"ids": []}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
    ({"ids": ["1"] * 21}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
    ({"ids": ["1", "abc"]}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
    ({"ids": ["1", 2]}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
    ({"ids": ["1", ""]}, (400, {"error": "invalid ids"})),
]
for params, expected in cases:
    got = handle_users_by_ids(params)
    assert got == expected, (params, got, expected)
print("all cases passed")
print("20 ids ok:", handle_users_by_ids({"ids": ["1"] * 20}))
PY
